newsitem.title: ISRAEL: TOP IMAGE SYSTEMS IN GERMAN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: TOP IMAGE SYSTEMS IN GERMAN DEAL.

text.p: Israel's Top Image Systems Ltd said on Monday it had entered a deal with German-based Gentriqs Software GmBH for the distribution of its form processing software in Europe.

"Strategic initiatives designed to build our distribution channel continue to yield positive results," said Stuart Melnick, executive vice president of Top Image. "Our agreement with Gentriqs and the agreement announced last month with Organizacion Companias de Seguros SA to distribute our products in Spain strengthen our presence in Europe."
The company did not release details about expected sales in Europe following the deal.
Top Image develops and markets a variety of form processing, information recognition and data entry systems and technologies.
Gentriqs is a systems integrator and developer of a hand-print recognition engine.
